description: Turner 2004 free energy (kcal/mol) of a given pseudoknot-free dot-bracket structure, with the same model as minimum_free_energy (ViennaRNA RNAeval -d2 counterpart).

rnaSequence.description: RNA sequence (T read as U, case-insensitive)

dotBracket.description: Structure of the same length using only '(', ')' and '.'

temperature.description: Absolute temperature in Kelvin (default 310.15 = 37 °C); every Turner 2004 parameter is rescaled with its enthalpy, dG(T) = dH - (dH - dG37)*T/310.15 (ViennaRNA md.temperature)

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Invalid structure (characters, balance, length or non-canonical pair)
